name: angular-auth-guard
description: Auth guard, interceptor, and login page for Angular route protection

agents.task: Create an Angular functional route guard using inject() and Router. Check authentication state (via an AuthService or token in localStorage/sessionStorage). Redirect to /login if not authenticated. Apply the guard to protected routes in the routing config.

Create an Angular HTTP interceptor that attaches the auth token (Bearer) to outgoing requests. Handle 401 responses by clearing the token and redirecting to login. Register it as a provider in app.config.ts or app.module.ts.

Create a login page component with a reactive form (email + password), validation, error display, and calls to an AuthService.login() method. On success, store the token and navigate to the home route.
Write unit tests for the auth guard (authorized and unauthorized cases) and the HTTP interceptor (token attached, 401 redirect).
